LastCycle.description:
The most recent cycle that has been measured, and what was measured.

Usually yesterday's. But from the moment reporting has measured today — in MEASURING, where
the finance officer reads the books, and in REVIEWING, where the CEO reviews the day — it is
today, still open: the review is *of* these numbers, and yesterday's would be the wrong day
(T-708 found both agents looking at an empty block).
LastCycle.title: LastCycle

OpportunityLine.description:
One thing the company might do, and how far it has got (T-611).

Kept short on purpose: the thesis and the evidence are a query away, and a CEO comparing
five opportunities needs the shape of each, not the case for it.

Put an article behind the paywall, or take it out. A person's decision for now: what is
worth paying for is a judgement about the reader, and no rule here would be honest.

Change a published (or taken-down) article (D-045). The site keeps the published version
until the new one is written, reviewed, approved and published.
Take a published article off the site (D-044). It stays, with its history, as ARCHIVED.

schema.title: Response Me Api Auth Me Get

post.description:
Open an order and build the form that opens PAYUNi's page.

Signing in comes first: the order records who a year is for, and a reader id is the only
name this layer has for anybody (D-018). Nothing is granted here — the order is PENDING
until PAYUNi says otherwise, even if the reader never comes back.

get.description:
What a month or a year costs here. ``available`` is false when that one is not for sale
yet, which is a fact about the site rather than an error — the page says "soon" instead of a
price.

schema.title: Response List Companies Api Companies Get
Response List Company Agents Api Companies  Company Id  Agents Get

post.description: Hire an agent: it appears in the office and starts taking its role's tasks.
No new tasks for this agent; the run it is on still finishes.
The agent leaves the roster. Its runs, events and outputs stay; it cannot be brought back.

schema.title: Response List Articles Api Companies  Company Id  Articles Get

get.description: The company's recent days, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Cycles Api Companies  Company Id  Cycles Get

get.description:
Cash, today's revenue and expenses (model calls included), today's goal, and whatever
each domain counted today under its own name.
The whole org chart in one call — what the office needs to draw its rooms.

Agents, active tasks, recent events and ``last_seq``, read at one consistent moment.
Connect the WebSocket with ``since=last_seq`` and apply newer events on top.

The CEO's view of the company: capital, goals, the portfolio, and what each domain put
in front of the decision. ``trimmed`` says what a size limit left out.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api Companies  Company Id  Sources Get
Response List Stories Api Companies  Company Id  Stories Get

get.description: Runs that ended badly and could be started again, newest first (AC-9).

schema.title: Response List Failed Api Companies  Company Id  Workflows Failed Get

post.description:
Run a failed workflow again, from the top, as a new run (AC-9).

The old run keeps its history: what failed and why is the reason to keep it. The company
may still refuse — the per-cycle cap on new work applies to a person's restart as much as
to the CEO's, because a runaway is a runaway whoever started it.

get.description: One day, in full: the plan, the numbers, the work, the summary and the timeline.
Events of one company ordered by ``seq``. Used for trace views and realtime gap-fill.

parameters.description: One workflow run's story: its events carry its id as correlation
parameters.name: correlation_id

schema.description: One workflow run's story: its events carry its id as correlation
schema.title: Correlation Id

post.description:
PAYUNi, server to server: this order was paid. The only thing that grants a year.

Answers ``1|OK`` once it has been dealt with, and 400 when it has not, because PAYUNi keeps
sending a notification nobody acknowledged — which is what we want when the database was
briefly unreachable, and harmless when the message was never PAYUNi's to begin with.
